name: Zeus vs Hades – Gods of War

features.name: Choose your god
features.description: Before free spins you choose between Zeus (lower variance) or Hades (higher variance) modes.

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds carry multipliers that combine when several are on a line.

review:
A really useful design idea: you choose your volatility inside the bonus by picking a god. Zeus gives steadier free spins with multiplier wilds; Hades can deliver much bigger results but often pays far less.

Playing both in demo is the easiest way to see how one choice changes the same game completely. Very high volatility, 15,000x max, 96.07% RTP.
cons: Lower default RTP than many Pragmatic titles
